message.name: AIR_CONTROL.NOTE
message.value: Use left/right keys to set the direction, where the strike is delivered.

dictionary.message: One of the basic weapons. Affected by the wind (especially, when shot with low power).
Standard grenade. It's quite easy to use as it's not affected by the wind.
Drill is used to dig down vertical tunnels. Sometimes can be used to slightly injure an enemy or drown him with kamikaze attack.
Allows you to dig tunnels under the ground. You can control the angle by up/down keys. Slightly injures and pushes the enemy.
Detonates in 3 seconds after setup, leaving a large hole in the ground. Heavily pushes the enemy.

Explodes in a second after any unit comes within its operating range. It can be used for defense, or as a source of additional damage. If there was no unit nearby while setting up a mine, the turn is not spent.
Simple but very useful weapon, makes 2 shots per turn. You may relocate your unit before making the second shot.
Tricky missile weapon. You can throw 4 shurikens for one turn. The first direct hit on each distinct enemy deals double damage.

message.name: SHURIKEN.NOTE
message.value: Most effective, when thrown at different enemies.

message.name: SHURIKEN.DAMAGE
message.value: 17 hp for the throw. The first direct hit at a target deals double damage.

dictionary.message: Cluster grenade, as a standard one, isn't affected by the wind. It does major damage by its fragments. It's very effective in enclosed space.

message.name: CL_GRENADE.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp from explosion, 8 fragments, 15 hp each.

dictionary.message: Simple but effective gun. Shoots with short bursts, almost no disperse. Can be controlled while shooting.

message.name: UZI.NOTE
message.value: While shooting you can change the angle of the weapon by 'up/down' keys.

dictionary.message: Weapon, similar to bazooka. The initial speed can't be regulated. A missile isn't affected by the wind. In explosion releases several fragments.

message.name: MORTAR.DAMAGE
message.value: 35 hp from explosion, 5 fragments, 25 hp each.

dictionary.message: Sticky grenade adheres to any surface. In explosion releases several explosive fragments, which are not influenced by the wind and flit to the air.

message.name: STICKY_BOMB.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp for explosion, 7 fragments, 20 hp each.

dictionary.message: Powerful close combat weapon. In competent hands it can tear an enemy to pieces. It shoots with widely spreading pellets.
Starts moving in the pointed direction but can turn around if struck into an obstacle or try to jump it over.

message.name: SHEEP.NOTE
message.value: Press SPACE to explode a ram at any moment.

dictionary.message: A controllable flying ram. It starts flying upwards when launched and explodes when bumps into the ground or any unit.

message.name: SUPER_SHEEP.NOTE
message.value: To control a ram use left/right arrows.

dictionary.message: A powerful and fast-firing weapon, capable of dealing great damage. However, it's rather inaccurate, so use it on close or middle range.
Shoots a missile, which bounces several times in a random direction. Unpredictable weapon, which may deal large damage to either an enemy or a teammate.
A missile, which can get an enemy hiding under the ground or behind an obstacle! It is influenced by the wind.
Close combat weapon based on the direct impact of electric charge on the biological target.

message.name: SHOCKER.NOTE
message.value: Tosses up damaged unit. Even more effective if you manage to hit several targets.

dictionary.message: A missile that goes for a target by the shortest flight path. It fits perfectly for long distances.

message.name: GUIDING_BAZOOKA.NOTE
message.value: Mark the target by the double mouse click, then adjust direction and power just as for regular bazooka.

dictionary.message: Shoots a cannon ball that detonates only after full stop. The shot power is not regulated. Attacking unit cannot move away after using the cannon.
Allows the user to relocate to the place, where the teleport happened to stop after a toss. Throw it just like a common grenade.

message.name: TELE_THROWER.NOTE
message.value: It can be used several times during a turn. Relocation doesn't spend a turn.

dictionary.message: Passes the turn to another teammate. One of the most important utilities!

message.name: SWITCH_TURN.NOTE
message.value: Use the left/right keys for switching between your team members. Use the SPACE key to choose a unit.

dictionary.message: Spider mine crawls up to an enemy and stands on it. If the enemy moves out, the spider will detonate immediately, dealing severe damage and poisoning the target.

message.name: SPIDER.NOTE
message.value: Spider will explode in 6 sec after moving starts, if there's no enemy on its way. The poison deals damage equal to 5% of the current hp at the end of each turn. Poison can be cured by any medkit. Doesn't damage units with less than 20 hp.

dictionary.message: Always flies upward, drilling through everything on its way. If it comes across a unit, firework will carry it to the sky.

message.name: FIREWORK.NOTE
message.value: It can be used to knock down the enemy, which stands above you.

message.name: FIREWORK.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp from the explosion. Units that were impaled by the firework also get 20 hp of damage plus the damage of falling to ground.

dictionary.message: Launched as a grenade. It detonates when it contacts the ground, covering it with flaming mixture.

message.name: MOLOTOV.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp out of explosion, fire damage: 30 hp per second.

dictionary.message: Throws streams of a burning napalm, which smolders on the ground for some time, burning the enemy.
Strikes with bombs that deal minor damage and ignite the ground.

message.name: NAPALM.DAMAGE
message.value: 5 rockets, 20 hp each. Fire damage: 30 hp per second.

dictionary.message: Drops 5 rockets at the pointed target. Rockets are not influenced by the wind.
Calls a devastating meteorite upon the earth. Meteorite falls on the ground at the random angle, on impact it breaks into 4 fragments.

message.name: METEOR.DAMAGE
message.value: 65 hp out of the strike, 4 fragments, 35 hp each.

dictionary.message: Strikes with 3 infernal carpets into the pointed target. Carpets are not influenced by the wind. When hitting the ground, carpets bounce to the random direction.

message.name: CARPET_STRIKE.NOTE
message.value: Use left/right keys to specify the direction, where the carpets should be thrown.

message.name: CARPET_STRIKE.DAMAGE
message.value: 3 carpets, 2 bounces, 50 hp of damage from every strike.

dictionary.message: An extremely powerful type of a cluster grenade. When exploding, watermelon breaks into 6 smaller fragments, which explode on contacting the ground.

message.name: WATERMELON.DAMAGE
message.value: Explosion damage: 80 hp, 6 fragments: 50 hp each

dictionary.message: Very powerful grenade. Explodes only after full stop. Attacking unit cannot move away after using it.
The most powerful strike, it drives an enemy to depression, taking the 35% of their current hit points and burying him in the ground.
Allows the unit to shift to any area, and even under the ground. Does small damage. Spends a turn.

message.name: TELEPORT.NOTE
message.value: To relocate double click on the desired point.

dictionary.message: Personal super light flying device, it lets you rise above the battlefield with the help of jet thrust.

message.name: JETPACK.NOTE
message.value: Remember, fuel is limited! After flying around you can switch to another weapon.

dictionary.message: A rope that can help you to climb up any obstacle.

message.name: ROPE.NOTE
message.value: Moving around with a rope doesn't spend a turn.

dictionary.message: Hooks up and pulls an enemy to the attacker, doing damage by electricity while dragging.

message.name: HARPOON.DAMAGE
message.value: 30 hp when hits a target, 10 hp each 0.25s while dragging.

dictionary.message: A unit attacked by this weapon, is sent flying with a very high speed. Ideal to push enemies into the water.
A decent and reliable weapon. It shots with bursts, one bullet can hit 2 enemies.

message.name: KALASH.DAMAGE
message.value: 2 bursts with 4 bullets. Each bullet deals damage of 16 hp.

dictionary.message: Strategic utility. Girders can be used as bridges, ladders or defensive constructions. Placing the girder doesn't waste your turn.

message.name: GIRDER.NOTE
message.value: Cannot be placed on the ground or near the units and other objects.

dictionary.message: Shoots special missile which freezes units within area of effect. Missile is affected by the wind.

message.name: FREEZER.NOTE
message.value: Frozen players cannot move, jump or use the rope for 2 turns. Ice block can be melted by fire or shattered by dealing 160 damage.

dictionary.message: Shoots 5 poisoned bolts, which are affected by the wind.

message.name: CROSSBOW.NOTE
message.value: The poison deals damage equal to 5% of the current hit points at the end of each turn. Poison can be cured by any medkit. Doesn't deal any damage if the unit has 20 hp or less remaining.

dictionary.message: Special mine that instantly freezes any unit who dares to approach it. If there was no unit nearby while setting up a mine, the turn is not spent.

message.name: FREEZING_MINE.NOTE
message.value: Frozen players cannot move, jump or use the rope for 2 turns. Ice block can be melted by fire or shattered by dealing 160 damage.

dictionary.message: Rocket stuffed with devastating shards that cause minor damage but destroy lots of landmass. Affected by the wind.

message.name: GROUNDBREAKER.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp from explosion, 10 shards, 10 hp each

dictionary.message: Special missile that digs the way down and detonates once it encounters any unit or reaches the water.
Enhanced modification of the bunker buster, deals significantly greater damage to the landscape.

Defensive device, jumps into the air when enemy approaches and attacks it. Can be triggered only by enemies standing on the ground. If there was no unit nearby while installing the guardian, the turn is not spent.
Absolutely indestructible barrier, no weapon can damage it.
Shoots with sharp discs, which bounce from any obstacle. Disc explodes when it hits the enemy or makes 4 bounces. Each bounce increases disc damage.
Nice choice for long distances. When you press SPACE while grenade is flying, it jumps up, and its damage increases. You can do up to 3 jumps.

It's now possible to attack enemy without leaving your hideout! Helicopter carries 4 bombs. Press SPACE, to drop them. If you press SPACE after using all of your bombs, helicopter falls and explodes. Picking a weapon crate with helicopter gives it additional bomb.

message.name: HELICOPTER.DAMAGE
message.value: Bomb damage: 25 hp, explosion damage: 30 hp.

dictionary.message: UFO is able to pick up and carry all kinds of mines: fly above the mine, press E or SPACE to capture it, then press E or SPACE again to release. If you press SPACE above the enemy, UFO falls on him end explodes.
Removes ice from the user and protects him from freezing and slowing for 2 turns. Also heals 50 hp. Spends a turn!
Force field generator which repels most kinds of ammo. Lasts for 10 turns.
Shoots with your unit at large distance. When the unit hits the ground, a large explosion happens. Your unit also takes 1/3 of the explosion damage.
When boomerang hits the enemy or the ground, it bounces at your direction, you may try to catch it and throw again. For the second throw, boomerang won't bounce. Greatly affected by the wind.
Instantly transfers unit to a random point at a middle range. Doesn't waste a turn. Can be used in the air.
Use the emergency teleport to get out of enclosed spaces without wasting a turn.
Heals half of the damaged received on previous turn. Each unit can be bandaged only once! Doesn't waste a turn.
It's wise to use bandage to counter enemy's combo, which dealt you a considerable damage.
Pushes an enemy with great force. You can shoot just below yourself to make a powerful jump and reach the high ground. Two shots per turn.
Despite low damage, a lucky shot can push your enemy far away. If you manage to hit the enemy while he is in the air, he definitely flies into the water!
Caution! Shoots a powerful energy ball affected by the wind. When it explodes, it fires lightning bolts to each unit in a large range.

message.name: THUNDERBOLT.DAMAGE
message.value: Ball damage: 95 hp, lightning damage: 70 hp.

dictionary.message: You should be very careful using the thunderbolt, as it's easy to damage your teammates with it. Great against grouped enemies or units standing near the wall.
Special devices generating protection beams. Your enemy will suffer damage and loose his turn, if he passes through the beam. Beams don't affect your team members. Doesn't waste a turn.
Barriers do little damage, though they are perfect for defense!
Restores 15 hp for 6 turns. Poison does no damage to you, while you're under antitoxin effect. Doesn't waste a turn.
Use antitoxin to prevent massive poison damage. Try to find a medkit, while you're protected.

Places a special mark on the map without spending a turn. On your next turn a bomb will be dropped at this mark. The bomb emits several explosions to the sides of epicenter. Enemies at the epicenter are poisoned for 10 turns.
This bomb is a powerful weapon, capable to destroy or sink several enemies. Your enemy has a vision of the mark - so make sure he won't be able to leave his position before explosion!
Gas grenade emits a cloud on explosion, which deals poison damage to all units it covers at the end of a turn, ignoring armor, attack, and dodge chance. Cloud lasts for 6 turns.
Can be used to force the enemy to change his position. Great against frozen targets. Remember, cloud damages your units as well, and it's not effective against units with poison protection!
Use up/down keys to change angle. Press and hold space to adjust power. Mind the wind!

Grenade is a good choice, when opponent stands in a crater at large distance. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key. Grenade is not affected by the wind and explodes on full stop.
Drill is irreplaceable if you choose Kamikaze tactics. Stand near your opponent and make a tunnel. If you are lucky, your opponent will fall down. Press SPACE to use.
There are two ways to use blow torch: to make your way through the obstacle or to push your opponent to the water. Press SPACE to use. You may change angle with up/down keys while moving.
Dynamite deals great damage and is good to send your opponents to the water. When dynamite is set, you have only few seconds to run away. Press SPACE to set.
Mine doesn't end the turn, if there are no units nearby . So, set up the mine and push your opponent on it for extra damage. Press SPACE to set.
Rifle is good to push your opponents to the water or on the mine. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
You may toss 4 shurikens per turn. To deal maximum damage, try to hit different opponents. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to throw.

The best way to use cluster grenade is to throw it to an opponent standing in a deeping. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key. Grenade is not affected by the wind and explodes on full stop.
Uzi deals good damage and can be used to push several opponents off the ground in one turn. Change angle with up/down keys, you can adjust angle even while shooting!. Press SPACE to use.
Mortar is a reliable, predictable weapon with constant power. It does more damage with high angles. Adjust angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Sticky grenade has a large coverage area and deals great damage in enclosed space. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key.
Shotgun is great at close combat. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Turn in desired direction and prace SPACE to launch. You can manually explode a ram at any moment by pressing SPACE again. But remember, that rams are unpredictable!
Press SPACE to launch. You can control the ram during the flight by left/right keys.
Minigun deals great damage, but has a low accuracy of fire, so it's better used at short distances. Adjust angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
It's a good idea to shoot carpets at large distances to avoid occasional ricochet hits. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key.
Drill rocket comes to help when your enemies are hiding deep under ground. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding the SPACE key. Mind the wind!
Shocker is a great weapon for throwing your enemies into the water. Stand next to your opponent and press SPACE to use. Remember that the effect is even greater if you manage to hit multiple targets.
First, double click on the map to set the mark. Then change angle with up/down keys. Adjust initial power with SPACE key.
You cannot move after shooting from cannon, so wisely choose the location. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Be careful, as portable teleport bounces from the ground and thus may trigger far from desired location .Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key.
The timer doesn't stop while you're selecting the unit, so decide quickly. Pick a unit with left/right keys. Press SPACE to select.
Don't stand near the opponent which has a spider under him - you may receive serious damage when he moves. Press SPACE to launch.
Use the firework to hit an enemy above, no matter how much ground is between you. Press SPACE to set.
Sniper rifle is much less effective in close combat, so shoot only from large distance. Adjust angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Molotov is a very powerful weapon. Best used against opponents in a deeping. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key.
Firethrower deals maximum damage, when opponent cannot drop off burning area. Adjust angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot. Mind the wind!
Change direction of attack with left/right keys. To launch the napalm just double click on the map. Make sure that the enemies won't easily drop off the fire.
Airstrike is good against group of enemies. Change direction of attack with left/right keys. Double click on the map to launch.
Use meteorite on open ground only, as the angle of attack is determined randomly. Double click on the map to attack.

Carpet strike is effective against large groups of enemies. Change direction of attack with left/right keys. Double click on the map to launch. Remember that this weapon is very powerful, but unpredictable.

Watermelon has a tremendous power! It's heavier than regular grenade, flies not so far and bounces from the ground. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key. Remember, you have 5 seconds to run away!
You cannot move after throwing holy grenade, so wisely choose the location. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key.
Sledgehammer literally nail your opponent down to the ground. You just have to use some fire weapon on your next turn. Stand in front of the enemy and press SPACE to hit.
Teleports your unit to any point on the map. Use it when there are no other ways to escape. Just double click on desired location to use.
Keep in mind, that the fuel is limited and turn timer is ticking. Press SPACE to take off. Use arrow keys to control the flight. Press SPACE again to land.
Rope is used to access the high ground. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to use.
Harpoon is useful when there is a water or a mine between you and your enemy, you can pull your opponent right there. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to use
Bat is the best way to send your enemy into a long flight straight to the water. Change angle with up/down keys. Stand in front of the enemy and press SPACE to hit.
Extremly effective in close combat. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot.
Use the girder to protect units that can be easily pushed to the water. Double click on the map to set up. Change angle with up/down keys.
Freezer will immobilize enemies that don't have jetpack or portable teleport. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key. Mind the wind!
Crossbow is useful at the beginning of the combat against high-level armored enemies. Change angle with up/down keys. Press SPACE to shoot. Mind the wind!
Unlike regular mine, freezing mine triggers immediately. Great in combination with other mines. Press SPACE to set up.
Groundbreaker destroys huge land masses. Be careful, as it is rather unpredictable. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key. Mind the wind!
Bunker buster is the most effective weapon agains opponents hidden underground. Double click on the map to launch.
Super bunker buster just tears the ground into pieces! Double click on the map to launch.
Guardian is a device that protects you from opponents that decide to come close to you. Press SPACE to set.
Titanium girder is especially useful to protect yourself or to block your opponent. Double click on the map to set up. Change angle with up/down keys.

Disc launcher has good chances to deal massive damage, if you use it against enemy group in enclosed space. Be careful - discs move very fast, and it's hard to dodge your own disc if it bounces in your direction.
Effective on medium and large distances, when you can perform at least 2 jumps. Change angle with up/down keys. Adjust power by holding SPACE key.
Use space key to drop bombs. Don't forget that helicopter deals additional damage with its explosion. If you accidently injure the controlling character, helicopter instantly goes down.
You can use UFO to drag aside enemy's guardians, or take the mines lying on the ground for additional damage. To deal direct damage, place UFO above the enemy and press space.
Even if antifreeze makes you to spend a turn, it's still the best move against ice users.
Force field provides good protection against most ammo, but its power may not be enough to deflect bullets or accelerated air strike.
Great for using by revived zombies and nearly dead units, as it is the easy way to inflict large amounts of damage.
Boomerang's bounce depends on the wind force and throw power. If you don't manage to catch the boomerang, it explodes with the next impact, dealing only half damage.

Device that can be attached to any surface, which disables common healing methods for your enemy. Doesn't affect most bosses and rabbit regeneration. If an enemy destroys the blocker, he gets considerable damage. Lasts for 6 turns.

Heal blocker should be used to counter enemy, who relies too much on medkits and regeneration. Use it, when an enemy digs under the ground to heal. Make sure enemy can't destroy the blocker with mines, try to attach it to high walls or ceiling.
Paraiste is thrown like a normal grenade, but it latches to enemy instead of exploding. On the next turn parasite will slow its victim and then explode in 10 seconds.

message.name: PARASITE.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp on latch, 40 hp more when triggered

dictionary.message: Parasite damage isn't the greatest, but its main purpose is to trouble your opponent on his next turn. Keep in mind that your enemy may use the turn switch to avoid the effect of the parasite.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_1
message.value: The troops get +6 to attack and armor while near the banner.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_2
message.value: The troops get +8 to attack and armor and +5 to regeneration while near the banner.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_3
message.value: All troops on the battlefield get a speed bonus. Troops also get +8 to attack and armor and +5 to regeneration while near the banner.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_4
message.value: All troops on the battlefield get a speed bonus and +5% to vampirism. Troops also get +8 to attack and armor and +5 to regeneration while near the banner.

message.name: BANNER_DESCRIPTION_5
message.value: All troops on the battlefield get a speed bonus and +5% to vampirism. Troops also get +10 to attack and armor and +5 to regeneration while near the banner.

dictionary.message: Releases 5 ice shards which go through any surface towards the crosshair damaging and freezing the enemy.
We think this weapon doesn't need any comments!

message.name: HALLOWEEN.NOTE
message.value: The weapon will disappear on December 1st.

dictionary.message: Ugly, filthy and absolutely useless pumpkin. Throw it into your enemy and it will replace his precious hat! Enemy's attack and armor is reduced by 10 point while wearing a hat, also minor damage is inflicted each turn. Lasts for 6 turns. Can be used 2 times per battle.
That's easy: use pumpkin on the enemy with the strongest hat.

After using this potion, your unit will be saved from the water. Also your unit gets 10 armor. Once your unit is saved, the protection fades away. But this power has its price - you'll have to pay 30% of your unit's current hit points. Can be used 1 time per battle.
Remember that you get the water protection only on the next turn! Don't try to sacrifice your own unit to drown the enemy!

Releases swarm of hungry spirits towards a target. Spirits pick random ally or enemy unit and rush through the ground to it. Damage of spirits increases, if the weapon user is wounded. If a spirit doesn't find a target, it attacks the user!
Just aim towards an enemy and shoot. Make sure there are no allies in the area of effect. If the enemy is too far, your soldier gets all the damage!
Snowball rolls on a ground, gathering all units it meets. Damage is increased with distance! After 4 seconds the snowball explodes. Great weapon to bury whole group of enemies!

message.name: SNOWBALL.DAMAGE
message.value: 1-60 hp when rolling over, 60 hp explosion damage

dictionary.message: Snowball grants dozens of ways to sink your enemies. Keep trying!
Lowers the ground temperature, dealing severe damage to all units. The more landmass is around a unit, the more damage it gets.
Use it to finish off your enemies, especially when they are hiding underground.
A real long-range artillery! Barrel shoots 6 rockets into the sky, which then fall and aim on random enemies. Ineffective in enclosed spaces!
Deals good damage if your enemies are on the open space.

Gift box is set like a regular mine and, when triggered, replaces unit's hat and artifact! After 6 turns the box disappears and affected unit gets random hat and artifact. Can be used on allies, in this case replacement happens on the next turn.
Versatile utility: push an enemy with a good hat on it or try to get better equipment for yourself with it.
Artillery shoots 6 homing missiles at 45 degrees at the given point. Rockets deal high damage and devastate the landscape greatly!
Double-click to set the point where you'd like to launch the missiles and press SPACE to place the artillery on the ground.
A new tool for saboteurs. Attaches to any surface, then acts as a common mine. If there was no unit nearby while setting up a mine, the turn is not spent.
You can throw sticky mine like any other missile - adjust the power by holding SPACE.
Laser beam easily cuts through both ground and your enemies! The beam can be controlled by up/down keys.
Laser can be as great for drowning as for damage. It can push even frozen enemies to the water.
A huge boulder, which tumbles chaotically over the map! Throws units into the air, dealing damage depending on boulder's speed.
Even though it's hard to calculate, you can deal guaranteed damage, if you throw the boulder strictly down at the enemy. Girders may help to create enclosed space for greater damage.

Greande can be activated by pressing SPACE! Creates a black hole, which draws surrounding units and objects. Units also get damage when colliding with ground under black hole's effect. Dissappears in 3 seconds, dealing additional damage.
Can be used to drown an enemy if activated in midair. Can deal huge damage in enclosed space.

message.name: BOOSTER.REWARD_X2.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Doubles experience and money earned in missions and boss fights.

message.name: BOOSTER.REWARD_X4.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Increases experience and money in missions and boss fights by 4 times.

message.name: BOOSTER.REAGENTS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Increases amount of reagents discovered in missions and boss fights by 30%.

dictionary.message: Restores 50hp to allies standing nearby. Bag user's healing bonus improves the effect. Doesn't heal the user himself!
The bag is especially great if you manage to target several allies.
Allows to stay under the water for 2 turns.
Use before diving!
Changes attack and armor of a target unit. Can be thrown at allies. Doesn't affect most bosses. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn. Doesn't spend a turn.
Make armored foe greatly vulnerable, increase ally's protection - this thing has many uses.
The pumpkin is set on a ground and ignites large area in front of it. Burning embers finally explode, dealing additional damage.

message.name: FIERY_PUMPKIN.DAMAGE
message.value: Fire damage: 30 hp per second. Embers damage: 35 hp.

dictionary.message: Push together several enemies and just burn them away!

Very stinky version of a common watermelon. It's ground destruction is a bit weaker, but it deals far greater damage and poisons units. Also this thing is rather fragile and explodes on second collision.

message.name: FOUL_WATERMELON.DAMAGE
message.value: Explosion damage: 90 hp, 6 stinky fragments: 65 hp each.

dictionary.message: This watermelon deals enormous damage, still destroying plenty of landmass. Really great deal.
Three graves drop into pointed location, revealing zombie troopers that join your team. Graves also deal moderate damage on landing.
Reliable reinforcements that can save the game. Use the landscape, so your enemy couldn't destroy them in one turn.

Forms 7 snowflakes above pointed location, which fall on the ground. Snowflakes can be cast away by the wind! On collision with ground they deal damage and freeze enemies for 3 turns, while landscape stays untouched.
Powerful air attack, we advise to train it a bit before going into real battle. Be careful, weapon is useless against enemies with cold protection!

A fresh unit from your team will be dropped at a given point after the next player's turn. There must be no obstacles above drop point. If there are no spare units in your team, you'll get a random mercenary of your level. New unit appears with 50% of normal health.
Calling for reinforcement will spend your turn and give your enemy chance to counter the threat. Make sure you'll survive a turn, and enemy won't destroy the ground beneath drop point.
Grenade is activated in 1.5 seconds after the throw, hanging in the midair and shooting nails at nearest units!
Try to throw this grenade so it affects only one enemy, in this case he'll get major damage. Remember that your own units can also be hit with this grenade!
Device which can be attached to any surface to damage nearby enemies that stay in the air for too long. Stays for 10 turns, increasing its radius every turn. Doesn't spend a turn.
Greatly disturbs enemy who relies on flying devices.

Changes the race of a unit it hits on random: crab (problems with aiming), snail (very slow), donut (great chance to dodge at low health). Dealing moderate damage. Doesn't affect bosses and their subordinates. Effect lasts for 5 turns.
It can prove very useful to get your opponent rid of his race abilities.
This mine can be put under the enemy and it tosses him up in 3 seconds, so you can attack him in midair. Doesn't deal damage and doesn't waste a turn.
Really shines in combination with pushing weapons. Feel free to experiment!

message.name: EXPLOSION_DELAY.NOTE
message.value: Explodes after full stop. You may set the timer for 1 second by holding SHIFT while charging.

message.name: BOOSTER.REACTION_SMALL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Rises your reaction level to 12, increasing the chances of going first in battles. If you already have level 12 or greater, it increases by 1.

message.name: BOOSTER.REACTION_LARGE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Rises your reaction level to 18, greatly increasing the chances of going first in battles. If you already have level 18 or greater, it increases by 2.

dictionary.message: Use the seal on a grave to raise a zombie fighting on your side. Doesn't waste a turn.
Keep your eye for the headstones, they're not useless granite slabs anymore!
Radiomast must be set in open space and starts working on your next turn. In active state it increases the damage of your air attacks by 40%. Doesn't waste a turn.
The mast can be set only in open space. Remember that your enemy may destroy the mast with his attacks or block it with girder.
Removes poison from your ally and restores 10% of his current hit points. Doesn't waste a turn.
Returns your poisoned teammate back to action! Your units can't use it on themselves!
Removes slowing and freezing effects from your ally. Doesn't waste a turn.
Removes all movement impairing effects from your teammate. Your units can't use it on themselves!
Torch with extremely hot fire, capable of melting even the most thick ice.

message.name: BUNDLE.CARROT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Great weapon pack that immediately puts you into aciton!

message.name: BUNDLE.FIRE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Really hot bundle to set your enemies on fire!

message.name: BUNDLE.AIR.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Breathtaking pack that brings destruction from above!

message.name: BUNDLE.ARMS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Bundle with heavy explosives to blast both your enemies and landscape!

dictionary.message: Decent rifle, allowing you to make one precise shot, carefully aiming with the laser beam. It is capable to pierce several enemies with one shot, but each subsequent target gets lower damage.

message.name: SNIPER_RIFLE.NOTE
message.value: The nearby targets get decreased damage.

dictionary.message: Places a special mark on the map without spending a turn. On your next turn a FAKE bomb will be dropped at this mark. Fake bomb behaves just like regular one, but causes much less destruction.
d Use the fake bomb to distract an enemy and make him spend resources to cover from atomic strike. Also feel free to use it for plain air damage.

Attention!
Different reaction boosters don't sum! Only the bigger bonus works.
A heavy anvil drops at target point, pushing a victim into ground and destroying lying objects. The anvil also stays on a ground, preventing enemy from getting out.
Great weapon to trap an enemy, if he doesn't have turn switch or emergency teleport. Anvil's ability to break ground while falling can be used to push enemies down to water.
Places a special mark on your unit's position. The unit then is teleported on this mark at the end of a turn. The mark lasts for 8 seconds.
It can be very useful to teleport back to safety after performing your turn.
Shoots a small girder, which gets stuck in the ground and stays on the map. Enemies hit by girder are pushed aside without taking any damage.
Lots of useful interactions! You may displace or block your enemy or cover your ally without wasting a turn.
All your troops are placed into ice blocks that protect from any damage (but not from drowning). Ice block shatters when a unit gets a turn.

The barrier can help you to escape from hard situation, for example when your main attacker is about to get killed, or your team is poisoned, or you are targeted by atomic bomb. Make sure there's enough landmass under your troops!
On explosion this missile blocks 3 random weapons for 3 turns in the arsenal of all victims. Also deals shock damage. Missile is affected by the wind!
Gives huge advantage if used at right moment, interfering your enemy's strategy.
When used, removes cooldown from one random weapon and equips it. Doesn't waste a turn!
The device is set on the ground and prevents ALL players from using airstrikes and all means of teleportation. Can be destroyed by regular attack. Doesn't waste a turn!
The soldier throws 4 grenades which are picked randomly from your backpack. All grenades are spent as on normal usage.
Launches 2 random missile weapons from your backpack with slight delay. Missiles used this way become blocked for 2 turns.
With this device you can block one of known weapons in enemy's arsenal for 2 turns. Must be used while standing near enemy unit. Doesn't spend a turn.
Launches the mole that digs the ground at given direction for 3 seconds. Mole explodes if it stumble upon an enemy, water, or empty space. The damage is increasing while mole is moving.

The turret is placed on a flat ground without wasting a turn. Requires an unblocked mortar in the arsenal. At the end of each turn shoots at random enemy within its range, using your mortar's ammo. Activates after the next enemy's turn, can be destroyed by normal attacks. Doesn't get a bonus from owner's attack. Performs up to 4 shots.

The turret is placed on a flat ground without wasting a turn. Requires an unblocked Minigun, AK-47, Uzi, Rifle or Sniper rifle in the arsenal. At the end of each turn shoots at random enemy within its range, using selected weapon's ammo. Activates after the next enemy's turn, can be destroyed by normal attacks. Doesn't get a bonus from owner's attack. Performs up to 4 shots.
Bombards the target point with random air missiles from your arsenal, wasting their ammo. Up to 8 missiles can be launched this way.
This device may save your life by removing cooldown from weapon, vital to finish your enemy.
Generator may secure your victory forbidding your enemy from escaping and healing or from finishing you with air strike.

Though you can't predict which grenades would be thrown, this weapon is capable of dealing tremendous damage. Especially when the enemy is staying in enclosed space, so the grenades won't spread away.
Two missiles - double effect. You can make the weapon more predictable by leaving only necessary missiles in backpack.
You can make the battle far more difficult for your enemy by blocking their rope or turn switch.

Great weapon against enemies who hide underground. It's better to launch mole at slight angle, to make it more difficult for enemy to escape out of the tunnel. Sometimes can be used to throw enemies into the water!
Additional damage at the end of turn is always handy, in the worst case the mortar will take some damage from enemy attacks. Mortar is especially useful against bosses.
Additional damage at the end of turn is always handy, in the worst case the turret will take some damage from enemy attacks. Turret is especially useful against bosses.
Huge amount of damage at the target point for the price of your air arsenal.

Emits an energy ball, burning everything on its way. Ball passes through ground, leaving a smoldering trail. Explodes on collision with enemy, igniting the nearby ground, and reducing enemy's fire protection by 20% until end of turn.

message.name: FIREBALL.DAMAGE
message.value: 40 hp out of explosion, fire damage: 30 hp per second.

dictionary.message: Like all other fire-based weapon, it's the most effective, when enemy is standing in enclosed space. Use it against enemies who are hiding underground, you may also try to straddle several enemies with the fire trail.

When thrown at any unit, gives regeneration of 10 hp per turn, reducing poison protection by 100% (protection can't become lower than 0). The effect lasts for 6 turns. Clears the effect of Antitoxin. Can be used on both enemies and allies, but doesn't affect most bosses. Doesn't spend a turn.
This potion allows you to poison even the enemies with high resistance, also can be used to heal your units at emergency.

message.name: BUNDLE.ANIMAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Who said that animals are inferior to machines?

message.name: BUNDLE.NAVAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Show that landlubbers who is the real sea dog here!

message.name: BUNDLE.SECRET.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This bundle is here by mistake, don't even try to buy it!

message.name: BUNDLE.TOXIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Dangerous poisons gathered from the most exotic places on the planet!

message.name: BUNDLE.BURNING.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Don't play with matches... take something more serious!

message.name: BOOSTER.WEEK_VIP.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Allows you to change race, rename characters and reset parameters for free.{br}Doubles experience and money earned in missions and boss fights.{br}Grants additional reagent in missions and boss fights.{br}Rises your reaction level to 18. If your reaction level is already 18 or greater, it's increased by 2.

message.name: BOOSTER.MONTH_VIP.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Allows you to change race, rename characters and reset parameters for free.{br}Doubles experience and money earned in missions and boss fights.{br}Grants additional reagent in missions and boss fights.{br}Rises your reaction level to 18. If your reaction level is already 18 or greater, it's increased by 2.

dictionary.message: Magic sphere of uncertain origin. Shoots multiple ice shards that aim towards enemies. Enemies hit by the orb are frozen for 2 turns. Enemies hit by at least 2 shards are slowed for 2 turns. Shards deal critical damage to slowed and frozen targets. Orb and shards are affected by wind!

message.name: CHROMEORB.DAMAGE
message.value: 50 hp orb damage, 30 hp shard damage

dictionary.message: Your units are protected from slowing caused by ice shards. Try to slow as much enemies as you can by throwing the orb with the maximum power.
Dark elixir grants +10 armor and saves from drowning once, teleporting character to random location instead.
Whene enemy sets a heal blocker, you can't restore health. But it will disappear in several turns!
When a character is in stasis, they can't be damaged. But it's still possible to sink them in water!
When character's repell chance is triggered, missiles may bounce away from them and fly to random direction!
Character has a chance to dodge attacks. Weapons that attack with lots of bullets are ineffective against them.
The character had a water protection. But now you can finally sink him, and he won't be saved this time!

message.name: BUNDLE.COLD.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Chill down the hottest enemies with your ice cold game!

message.name: BUNDLE.JUDGMENT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Cast a real apocalypse for your foes!

message.name: BUNDLE.CRIMINAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: The best weapons of local bandits – this will definitely help you!

message.name: BUNDLE.MINER.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Are you ready to bury your enemies under tons of earth?

message.name: BUNDLE.RARITY.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This dusty crate was found in cellars of forsaken castle... Who'll get the ancient treasures now?

message.name: BUNDLE.FORBIDDEN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Revolutionary weapons, altering the physical properties of matter...

message.name: BUNDLE.FESTIVE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Make a holiday any time you wish - how's your enemy is going to counter that?

message.name: BUNDLE.PERSIAN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Nobody knows the history of this crate but we can tell for sure: its contents are deadly!

message.name: BUNDLE.POLICE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Are you brave enough to rein in any villain? This bundle is for you!

message.name: BUNDLE.ENGINEERING.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Quickly buy this bundle, while its owners frogot about it!

message.name: BUNDLE.STORM.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Cover any battlefield with a storm cloud from this crate!

message.name: BUNDLE.GROUND.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Born to crawl can't fly, but it's possible to punish those who try to escape!

message.name: BUNDLE.SPYWARE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A crate filled with spy gadgets – are you ready to amuse enemies with such toolkit?

message.name: BUNDLE.SAVING.DESCRIPTION
message.value: You can't find more joy in this gray world? The bundle for most confusing scenarios is what you need!

message.name: BUNDLE.HEAVENLY.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Fly like a dragon, crush like a rhino!

dictionary.message: Doll is thrown as grenade and attaches to enemy it hits . Doll prevents most types of healing (doesn't work on most bosses). To remove a doll its victim must get 150 damage from themselves or from allies.

message.name: PUPPET.DAMAGE
message.value: 10 hp on hit, 10 hp on destruction

dictionary.message: The doll doesn't deal much damage. Its role is in preventing enemy's healing and forcing them to deal damage to themselves. Just use it on enemies with high regeneration!

Enemy unit hit by elixir is put to sleep during your turns, removing dodge and repell effects from them. The effect lasts for 4 turns. Doesn't waste a turn. Doen't affect most bosses and dodging cats.
A reliable way to make vulnerably your most dodgy enemies!

Huge carnivorous flower. Attacks moving enemy in area of effect, dealing severe damage and pushing them aside. Disappears after 3 attacks. Only one Harry at time is allowed! Can't be placed if there's only 1 enemy left!

message.name: HUNGRY_GARY.DAMAGE
message.value: 90 hp per attack, flower has 200 hit points

dictionary.message: Harry is an excellent defender of your tactical interests on the map!

Exchanges your unit with any other in the radius of effect. All your devices at point of teleportation are destroyed by explosion. After using both units receive knockback reduction for 1 turn. Each unit can participate in reverse teleport only once per battle! Can't be used close to water.

message.name: SWAP_TELEPORT.NOTE
message.value: Use left/right arrows to choose units, press SPACE to select.

dictionary.message: Turn timer is still ticking while you select a unit, so try to use it faster. Use left/right arrows or A/D to choose units, press SPACE to select.
Releases aggressive robopiranhas to the water. At the end of a turn they attack nearest unit that stands close to water, both enemies and allies. Disappear after attack. Doesn't affect most bosses.
Robopiranhas stay in water till the end of battle, but attack only once.

message.name: ROBO_PIRANHA.NOTE
message.value: Better keep far from water, when piranhas are active, it's very easy to waste a turn on them!

message.name: BUNDLE.RURAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This bundle contains a secret of strange Farmer's apples!

message.name: BUNDLE.MUSIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This bundle makes music sound differently!

message.name: BUNDLE.HAIRDRESSING.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Fascinating bundle of nice haircuts and Zombie with an axe as as bonus.

message.name: BUNDLE.LOST.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Box of wonders with curios arrived to us from the heart of Antlantis!

message.name: BUNDLE.NIGHT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: With this bundle you feel safe walking in the dark of a night, looking for adventures.

message.name: BUNDLE.TIBETAN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: With this bundle you may conceive the true mastery of Tibetan monks!

message.name: BUNDLE.MEXICAN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Grab this hot bundle faster, until it burns the land down to Mexico!

message.name: BUNDLE.SPACE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Somewhat useful set, if you suddenly decide to travel to dee space for vacation!

message.name: BUNDLE.BLACK.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Elite gear of legendary cats in black - that's what you really need right now!

message.name: BUNDLE.THIEVES.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Great master Boaryaki-kun hooked us up with this bundle for unspeakable price.

message.name: BUNDLE.SWAMP.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Eerie creature attacked local tourists ever and again, until one of them happened to carry a jackhammer.

message.name: BUNDLE.SIBERIAN.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This frozen land contains thousands of riddles, the main of them how this crate got there?

message.name: BUNDLE.SHAMANIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Do you want to become a master of elements? Than this bundle is for you!

message.name: BUNDLE.SMALL_HEALERS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: War is war! No holds barred! This small bundle will help you to win!

message.name: BUNDLE.MIDDLE_HEALERS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Medium healer's bundle is irreplaceable in combat! No Wormix master of martial arts can do without it!

message.name: BUNDLE.LARGE_HEALERS.DESCRIPTION
message.value: What can be better than this huge bundle? This pile of supplies saved brave Wormix fighters numerous times!

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-S.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Every war dog needs a box of professional tools to assist him in combat!

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-M.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Medium bundle of professional equipment will help in difficult battles!

message.name: BUNDLE.PROFI-L.DESCRIPTION
message.value: This is war! A huge case of a professional fighter will lead you to victory!

message.name: BUNDLE.SEASONAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Contents of this box defies logic: it changes by itself over the time. You can buy wonders for money nonetheless!

message.name: BUNDLE.FAIRY_TALE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A villain from this tale didn't have money for a dragon, so he put an asian mask on first available servant. There was no princess as well, and the knight just passed by... Humble, thrifty, a bit ridiculous – but everything fits this box!

message.name: BUNDLE.GREAT.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Why the helm is great? Because noone could loose it in such despicable way, that accident is now history – get it faster before others find it on a shelf!

message.name: BUNDLE.STRATEGIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: These items belonged to someone from ancient civilization. Huge ice cube, hat with ancient symbols, arctic sword – it's everything that left.

message.name: BUNDLE.HOMEMADE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Our workers decided to decorate a common hat with toxins, antidotes, potions... Mixing all the trash together they've got THIS. Want to get some?

message.name: BUNDLE.DEMONIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A package from underworld with a strange shield inside. Rumor has it, that the Lord of Hell watches everything above through the eye on this artifact.

message.name: BUNDLE.MYSTICAL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: All who stay near this crate hear groans. Lingering and desperate as if there's not a strange stick with spikes inside, but hundreds of suffering souls.

message.name: BUNDLE.WILD.DESCRIPTION
message.value: One day we've caught a savage, who was stealing antitoxins – like he spent all of his life outside of civilization. And he couldn't just get away with this...

message.name: BUNDLE.GHOST.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Strange things happen in this place: thunder is sounding and lightnings are flashing. There's a rumor that if you manage to dispel this sorcery, you'll get a magical hat!

message.name: BUNDLE.GOLD.DESCRIPTION
message.value: What happens if you ram a jetpack with UFO in the middle of a desert, then pour top-quality napalm on this, and finally toss a ruby? If we mention that this thing is scandinavian, it's a good item to scare the pants off your enemies!

message.name: BUNDLE.DIPLOMATIC.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Our diplomats could explain to the Emperor, that they don't need his treasure, and they will remain friends if he grants them one of his hats. Now that ruler has a barrel of toxins, and you have an opportunity to buy a rare item!

message.name: BUNDLE.EAGLE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Druids that live in local forests tame animals and speak with the trees. If you catch one of them, you may scrounge a good item.

message.name: BUNDLE.UNSUCCESSFUL.DESCRIPTION
message.value: One affluent researcher leaked a hint that Sword of depths was developed by Engineer, improved version of Vampiric sword. Nobody could discover an upgrade technology, but lots of useful knowledge remained from experiments...

dictionary.message:
Attention!
Duration of identical items sums up!

message.name: BUNDLE.SECRETIVE.DESCRIPTION
message.value: A solitary hermit, a master of martial arts, roamed the snowy peaks and found a bandage of a fallen robot. Just think what effect this had... The old veteran carried this secret to the grave, but it could not be hidden.

message.name: BUNDLE.CURSED_NEON.DESCRIPTION
message.value: Cursed jade is the most mysterious thing in the game. Manipulations with ice, toxic substances and gravity in a complete vacuum... There's a few experimental tanks left - take it, before someone else gets it and brings it on you!

message.name: HAT.WATER_PROTECTION
message.value: Saves from drowning once per battle

message.name: HAT.HAM_HEAL
message.value: When your life drops below 30% restores {value} health and is replaced with other item

message.name: HAT.WATER_PROTECTION_FIRST_ACT
message.value: Protection from water until unit's first turn
